text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of Tokai Teio's debut has finally

arrived...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how much longer? Is my race gonna
start
anytime soon?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe? My heart's beating pretty
fast.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But it's also because I just wanna hurry
up and run
already! ...I think!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it's not a bad thing. So don't
worry
about me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Here I go! The legend of Teio
begins now!
choice_data_list: Go out there and run your heart out!
